resumeText:
JORDAN MCALLISTER
Melbourne, VIC | 0400 123 456 | jordan.mcallister@example.com
Australian citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Hard-working, passionate individual with a strong desire to learn and grow. Motivated team player who is dedicated, reliable and eager to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

SKILLS
Swift, Kotlin, Java, Firebase, REST APIs, SQLite, Git, Figma, Agile/Scrum

EXPERIENCE

Junior Developer (Contract)
BrightPath Digital, Melbourne
02/2024 - Present
- Responsible for writing REST APIs and attending daily stand-ups.
- Responsible for fixing bugs reported by QA team.
- Responsible for updating Firebase database schemas as required by product team.
- Responsible for participating in sprint planning and retrospectives.

Cafe Supervisor
Millstone Coffee House, Melbourne
06/2021 - 01/2023
- Opened and closed the store, managed cash reconciliation and rostering for casual staff.
- Trained new baristas on espresso equipment and customer service standards.

Retail Assistant
Urban Outfitters Co, Melbourne
03/2019 - 07/2021
- Assisted customers with product selection and handled point-of-sale transactions.

PROJECTS

TrailMate - Hiking Companion App
- Built a native Android app using Kotlin and Firebase to let users log hikes, track distance and save favourite trails.
- Implemented offline caching with SQLite so users could view saved trails without a connection.
- Designed the UI in Figma before development, following Material Design guidelines.

PocketBudget - Personal Finance Tracker
- Developed an iOS app in Swift with a REST API backend to help users categorise expenses and set monthly budgets.
- Used SQLite for local data persistence and built custom chart views to visualise spending patterns.

EDUCATION

Diploma of Mobile App Development
CoderForge Academy, Melbourne
01/2024 - 12/2024 (Boot camp - part time evenings)

Certificate III in Business
Melbourne TAFE Institute
02/2018 - 11/2018

REFERENCES
Available on request
